lines.text: It’s project time! Build a helpful assistant app: ask at least two questions, store the answers in variables, calculate with operators, decide with if/else, reply with a joined message, and validate odd inputs.
Build a helpful assistant: a study timer planner, a pocket-money calculator, a recipe scaler, a fitness helper — your choice.
Every app follows this pattern: get input (ask), process it (variables, operators, decisions), and give output (say).
Check the input is sensible (e.g. not negative) and respond kindly if it isn’t.
Write a test table: input, expected output, actual output.
Include normal, boundary and invalid inputs.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
